authority.identity: The XerahS build loop under the maintainer's delegated owner-block authority (root AGENTS.md Stewardship); decided by agent opencode (GLM 5.3) with the sources recorded in decisions/EO-004-save-as-defaults.md

source.statement: Decision EO-004-SAVE-AS-DEFAULTS-2026-11-19 resolves the recorded open questions for EO-004: the reachable Save As set is confirmed as PNG, JPEG and WebP as the approved SPEC already requires; JPEG and WebP quality default to 90 following ShareX TaskSettings.cs (ImageJPEGQuality = 90, ImageWebPQuality = 90) and GIMP's JPEG export default (plug-ins/file-jpeg/jpeg.c quality 0.9); the JPEG transparent-pixel background defaults to white (#FFFFFF) following ShareX's flatten path (TaskHelpers.cs FillBackground(Color.White)), satisfying the recorded alternative of a documented, prefilled, user-overridable default; WebP lossless exposure and the export color-profile/metadata policy are recorded deferred follow-ups, not v1 requirements. format-disposition.json becomes decided with the defaults recorded. The other fifteen packages carry forward to contract 0.4.1 unchanged in normative text from 0.4.0, where the 2026-11-14 CORE-025 record approved them; the deciding agent verified that carry-forward by inspecting this commit's diff, which touches no other capability package. No encoder, path, sidecar or settings behavior changes, and no ROOT constitution rule is changed.

remaining_gates: conformance before activation; release requires Mike
